query:
ALTER TABLE users 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verificationStatus ENUM('unverified', 'payment_pending', 'identity_pending', 'funds_pending', 'review_pending', 'verified', 'rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified',
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verificationTier ENUM('none', 'basic', 'verified', 'premium') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verifiedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verificationExpiresAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripeIdentitySessionId VARCHAR(255) NULL,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS plaidAccessToken VARCHAR(255) NULL,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fundsVerifiedAmount INT NULL;
